purpose: Implement the predeclared Gate-5 N=50 full-input per-replica extraction and complete-family manifest gate

architecture.why: extract_fullevent_fps.py is Gate-4 pinned; the dedicated adapter calls its model reconstruction, engine reweight, coverage checks, xsec arithmetic, and atomic writer without changing those bytes
two_runtime_stages: ROOT CPU cross-section extraction in the same array task
architecture.collision_isolation: replicas/replica_XX/extraction with no-clobber guards and one writer per replica
architecture.complete_manifest_policy: afterany terminal validator reports the declared family as a whole; 49/50 is BLOCK, never a selected subset

gate5_contract.full_signal_factor: canonical replay required; applied to every truth count and to completeness/reporting-mask construction
gate5_contract.background_factor: canonical replay required; bound to the per-replica Stay-Positive target already used for training; no background row enters truth-space xsec binning
gate5_contract.full_ordered_coverage: w_push and mc_indices must cover exactly arange(49152885)

acceptance.command: module load tensorflow/2.15.0 && python3 -m pytest -q nd-unfolding/tests/test_gate5_replica_extraction.py nd-unfolding/tests/test_gate5_replica_driver.py nd-unfolding/tests/test_fullevent_extract.py nd-unfolding/tests/test_fullevent_fps.py nd-unfolding/tests/test_reconcile_gate5_family.py
acceptance.revision_scope: implementation worktree at code_parent 05564cf plus the files hash-bound above

resource_route.array: 50 A100 tasks, at most 10 concurrent, 2h wall each; measured analogous full push completed within a 14m06s diagnostic job and used about 6.9 GiB MaxRSS
resource_route.interactive_rejected: the declared 50-member family needs ten concurrent independent GPUs and durable completion beyond one interactive allocation; batch is the dependency-safe route
